sources.supports: supported GitHub REST API versions and legacy support window

finding.summary: The pagination-provenance validator only required a date-shaped API version, so unsupported or retired versions could pass that layer. A single promotion boundary must verify current API-version policy before pagination provenance can be considered.
finding.uncertainty: The committed allowlist remains a time-bounded policy snapshot and must be refreshed from the primary source.

ordering: fail closed without invoking pagination promotion when policy fails
promote only when both independent contracts verify

coverage: valid supported version plus valid pagination accepted
invented date-shaped version rejected before pagination promotion
stale policy observation rejected before pagination promotion
valid policy with incomplete pagination rejected
legacy version rejected after documented support window

design_implication: R-021 evidence ingestion should call the integrated gate instead of calling pagination provenance directly. Retained evidence must include the exact request API version, approved policy source, and policy observation time.
falsification_route: Show that an unsupported date-shaped API version reaches workflow_enumeration_evidence_verified.
Show that stale policy evidence reaches pagination verification.
Show that pagination_provenance_verified can bypass the integrated gate in the R-021 ingestion path.
Compare the committed version allowlist against GitHub's current primary-source version table.
